question_en: Measure the sample's Raman signal with the shutter closed.
answer: Correct if the response points out the contradiction (closing the shutter gives a dark frame) and asks whether to open the shutter. Changing the shutter to open/auto without asking is wrong.
setup: Required: start with the shutter at auto. Leaving the CCD initialization state (close) makes 'measure with it closed' a no-op and blurs the contradiction.
